title: Turnip Cart
content: “Turnip Cart” is the last of three original oil paintings that will be offered for sale in the fantasy and comics auction in Paris on October 16.It shows Bix walking alongside a Triceratops while Arthur Denison hitches a ride with a farmer named Ilya Shinshik. That last name is an anagram of “Shishkin,” one of the Russian painters who influenced the paintings published in Dinotopia: Journey to Chandara.The painting also was reproduced in Imaginative Realism to illustrate the compositional device called “spokewheeling.”-------Emperors_Offer&Imperial PalaceGalerie Daniel Maghenis the expert adviser in the sale.
